name: hipaa-pii-compliance-sandbox
description: Local TypeScript microservices sandbox for testing a HIPAA (PHI) / PII compliance check agent.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n patient,notify -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w patient-service" "npm run dev -w notification-service"
scripts.start: concurrently -n patient,notify -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w patient-service" "npm run start -w notification-service"
